title: Airfare of the Week: Turkish Airlines Economy Class Melbourne – Barcelona from $1,148 Return
body:
Australian Frequent Flyer
Australian Frequent Flyer - Tips, Tricks and Chat for Australian Frequent Flyers
Barcelona, Spain.
Our newest Airfare of the Week belongs to Turkish Airlines, which has round-trip Economy Class fares from Melbourne (MEL) to Barcelona (BCN) from $1,148.
This is a sharp price for a full-service airline to Europe, with meals and a checked bag included. You can even add a stopover in Istanbul or Singapore along the way for a small fee.
Here are the full details of this great Economy Class airfare from Melbourne to Barcelona.
Sample itinerary & pricing
You can book this fare directly on the Turkish Airlines website .
While Barcelona appears to be the cheapest destination, fares to other European cities such as Madrid and Milan start from $1,183. Similar pricing is available from Sydney.
Note that fares and availability are subject to change. This fare may not be available by the time you read this article, and you might need to be flexible with travel dates. We recommend booking ASAP to avoid disappointment!
Travel dates & fare rules
Here are the details of this airfare:
Book by 31 October 2026
Travel must commence between 1 February and 31 March 2027
Two stopovers permitted for USD70 (~AU$101) each – one in Türkiye and one in Singapore – of up to five days each
Change fee: USD250 (~AU$360) plus any fare difference before departure
Cancellation: Not allowed before departure or in case of no-show. A full refund is available within 24 hours of ticketing if the ticket was purchased at least seven days before scheduled departure
Open-jaws with other European ports are allowed
On-board product
Turkish Airlines A350 at Guarulhos Airport. Photo: Matt Graham.
Turkish Airlines flies its Airbus A350-900s from Melbourne to Istanbul via Singapore. Economy Class seats on this aircraft are in the typical 3-3-3 layout, each with a personal entertainment screen and USB power. You can check out AFF’s review of Turkish Airlines A350 Economy Class.
Turkish Airlines A350-900 Economy Class seats in row 29. Photo: Matt Graham.
Onward flights to Barcelona are mostly operated by narrow-body Airbus A320 or A321neo aircraft, but some are operated by wide-body Airbus A330s. Turkish Airlines is well regarded for its Economy Class catering, and meals and drinks are included on every flight – including the shorter hop between Istanbul and Barcelona.
Earning points & status credits with this airfare
This fare books into “U” class. This is a deeply-discounted fare class, and no Star Alliance program apart from Turkish Airlines Miles&Smiles awards any miles for “U” class at all.
If you credited these flights to Turkish Airlines Miles&Smiles, you would earn 25% of the miles flown. That’s around 5,200 miles for the round trip. On a positive note, these flights might allow you to complete the requirements of a Turkish Airlines status match .
